summary: The fund is an ETF that seeks to meet its objective by having Corgi Strategies, LLC actively manage the fund and, under ordinary market conditions, invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in a portfolio of companies materially involved in drones and unmanned aircraft systems and urban air mobility and advanced air mobility technologies and services that the adviser believes are positioned to benefit from the adoption of aerial robotics and next-generation aviation across commercial, industrial, public safety, and government and defense end markets. It is non-diversified.
